en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3182 - It is narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, who said:

I read the letter of Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (as) which stated:
"Convey to my Shia that my visitation is equivalent before Allah (swt), the Exalted, to one thousand Hajj."
I then asked Abu Ja‘far (his son, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Jawad (as)) "One thousand Hajj?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, by Allah (swt), and one thousand thousand Hajj for the one who visits him knowing his right."
